summary: Kanzhun Limited filed a Next Day Disclosure Return with the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, reporting share repurchases for cancellation and share issuances under equity incentive plans. The company repurchased 7,960,118 shares across 15 trading sessions between May 27 and June 17, 2026, at prices ranging from $6.6741 to $7.2478 per share. Additionally, 8,000 shares were issued upon exercise of options at $5.33, and 1,070 restricted share units vested at $0. Watch for ongoing buyback execution and potential cancellation impact on share count.
